text: Personally, I think the initial visits to this clinic were good, but after the blood tests were done, the doctor's attitude became very unpleasant. (In my case, my wife is 35 years old, so amniocentesis and blood tests were necessary.) For example, when I asked questions, the doctor would hesitate and be reluctant to answer. This has been going on for about 5 months now. Initially, they said, "You can continue with me, it's okay, I'll take care of you." (At that time, I had already informed them that I wanted a natural birth, not a C-section. In the beginning, we didn't know what was what, but now we're going to switch clinics; we're done with this one.)
The doctor was very polite and gave great encouragement during childbirth.
